line: Blur the signs, hide the spot. One AI, one try.
Here's my street photo, with more signs blurred.
I give it to ChatGPT and ask where this was taken.
It checked fifteen websites, then gave its guess.
It guessed the city and the area. Not the street.
So, does blurring keep it secret? Only in part. The street stayed hidden, the area did not.
It also asked for the raw file.
It said the info inside could narrow it down. I can't check that.
Try it on your photo. Blur the signs, then ask the same question.
Send this to anyone who posts photos.
The setup's in the link in bio.
Follow for the setup that actually works.
